endpoint_policy.environment_selection: uni_env === 0 → test host; otherwise production. Admin must not supply arbitrary URLs.

lifecycle.success: persist trusted redirect; PATCH/local bank_sent_process1; redirect customer
lifecycle.definitive_failure: only remote SmartUCF rejection → bank_send_failed_smartucf locally and CP
lifecycle.pre_send_failure: certificate/sync/validation failure is retryable; do not write bank_send_failed_smartucf
lifecycle.ambiguous_post_send: timeout, stale submitting, duplicate evidence, invalid post-send response → outcome_unknown; no auto resend; tell customer not to resubmit

idempotency: created attempt replays stored trusted redirect; never a second SmartUCF session

certificate_sync.transient_cp_metadata_failure: fail open only with a complete valid local pair
